turns: How many rides were requested in each month of 2026?

turn_records.message: How many rides were requested in each month of 2026?
turn_records.understood_as: How many ride requests were made in each month during the year 2026?
turn_records.sql:
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', requested_at) AS month,
    COUNT(*) AS ride_requests
FROM rides
WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM requested_at) = 2026
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', requested_at)
ORDER BY month;
